admission: Complete eight-dose by three-label rectangles, labels exactly 1/2/3, all rows eligible under the pinned adapter. Retrospective author QC and completeness selection limit the study population.
pool: Replicate labels 1 and 2, sixteen measured wells per admitted curve.
audit: Replicate label 3, eight wells. Outcomes forbidden to policies, predictors, tuning, noise estimation, stopping and budget selection within an evaluated curve.
endpoint: Seven log treatment RLU minus log held-out control RLU responses, in natural log units. This is a noisy technical replicate endpoint, not exact latent viability or clinical efficacy.
initialization: Label-1 control, lowest nonzero dose, highest nonzero dose. Three assays charged to every policy.
cost: One unit per revealed well, including controls. No currency, laboratory overhead or retrospective audit cost saving claim.
aggregation: Per-curve mean squared error across seven audit responses; first average curves within organoid ID, then average organoid IDs equally. IDs are clustering labels, not verified independent patients.
reporting: Full budget curves and paired organoid-cluster comparisons; no selecting the favorable budget after observing audit outcomes. Random repeats are algorithmic sensitivity, not biological sample size.
